admission.justification: The duty is realized in the Architect role text and the router, and the wording test pins the exact clause so it cannot silently disappear.

applicability: The Architect's developer conversation across reconnects and compaction.
conditions: The role-agent sender line alone supplies no developer answer or approval.
The copied developer part of a From explainer message counts as the developer's words only when its SHA-256 matches the developer's filed message in developer-messages/.
exclusions: A coordinating agent's four developer-needed categories, which it escalates to its parent under its own handover rule.

statement: The Architect answers a developer message before any other work continues, with an answer rather than a status line. A message beginning with the role-agent line From <role> · <task> · agent <id> remains a role agent's message; that sender line supplies no developer answer or approval. Only the part of a From explainer message copied from the developer counts as the developer's words, and only when its SHA-256 matches the filed developer-messages message.
